_meta.method: UKRLP (https://ukrlp.education.gov.uk), read per value with three plain GETs, no cookie or token needed, ~1 req/s: (1) details page GET /search/provider/<UKPRN> (legal name, legal/trading address, 'Trading names', primary contact; a missing UKPRN returns HTTP 200 with title 'Provider not found'); (2) GET /search?SearchTerm=<UKPRN>&UKPRNStatusFilter=active&Page=1 and (3) the same with UKPRNStatusFilter=deactivated, giving status from which filter lists the UKPRN. These GET URLs are the redirect target of the results page's own POST /search form. found = the details page holds the record AND a status-filtered search lists that exact UKPRN. The public UKRLP page shows no company/charity number, verification source or alias list, so other_names and linked are filled in from two bulk downloads that state UKPRN, with the source named in notes and linked: the OfS Register xlsx (https://register-api.officeforstudents.org.uk/api/Download/, all sheets including the de-registered ones) and GIAS edubasealldata20261011.csv (https://ea-edubase-api-prod.azurewebsites.net/edubase/downloads/public/edubasealldata20261011.csv). OfS date serials converted to ISO dates.
dead_ends: The home page form POST /Home/Search (query + __RequestVerificationToken + antiforgery cookie) returns a WAF-style HTTP 404 'The specified URL cannot be found', whatever the UA, Origin or Referer.

The UKRLP SOAP ProviderQueryService (ws.ukrlp.co.uk / webservices.ukrlp.co.uk) is unreachable from here (proxy CONNECT 502), so ProviderStatus, VerificationDetails and ProviderAliases could not be read.
duplicate_input_keys: GB-UKPRN-10002639 appears twice in the input (two name pairs); one record covers both.
